issue_context.summary: A PowerToys Run diagnostic reports Calculator static initialization failing because System.Runtime.Numerics 8.0.0.0 cannot be loaded.
known_information: Open Issue-Bug with PowerToys Run/Run-Plugin labels; no assignee.
Body includes a Store-install diagnostic from PowerToys 0.80.0.0 on Windows 11 22H2.
Exception chain names Calculator.Main, Mages.Core.Runtime.Global, and missing System.Runtime.Numerics 8.0.0.0 during plugin settings enumeration.
Only comment, by htcfreek on 2024-04-27, identifies a crash in PowerToys Run's Calculator plugin.
inferences: A missing/incompatible runtime dependency is plausible, but source evidence does not distinguish package, dependency-version or deployment-specific causes.
The old failure may not apply to current releases; current packaged reproduction is the key discriminator.
issue_context.analysis: The stack trace is specific enough for a yellow dependency hypothesis rather than a generic request for logs. Current-build reproduction is necessary before deciding on a package change.
initial_investigation: Read complete body/exception, labels, assignees and the sole comment; latest comment is https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/32624#issuecomment-2080578729.
No linked PR or confirmed fix appears in the public record; noted conflicting template/diagnostic version and relied on the pasted diagnostic for occurrence evidence.
